result.trend_context: H1 is not a fresh impulsive uptrend from multi-day highs; it is a post-selloff recovery: sharp 01-18 decline, base near ~1.132, then higher lows into ~1.134–1.135 at entry. Bias is mild bullish recovery, not mature trend extension.
result.range_location: On the decision M1 window, most pre-break action lives in a multi-hour lower range ~1.1340–1.1342 under the SL/entry shelf. Entry is a late break of that local shelf toward the top of the visible M1 range, while H1 remains mid-recovery rather than range extreme of the full H1 window.
result.breakout_geometry: BUY breakout geometry: tight SL just under the prior compression high/shelf, wide TP far above Entry. The break is expressed as a late green expansion through Entry after prolonged base; stop is close to recent noise, reward stretch is asymmetric upward.
result.book_trace_context: CME 6E direction-aligned break-bar book is only mildly positive overall (score +0.067). Early book is negative (-0.021), late book nearly flat (+0.001), and the path is choppy with frequent median/actual divergences, so book support is weak rather than decisive.

Late actual entry near 300s after break-bar open
Weak/negative early book and only flat late book
